title: The settlement cannot be persisted: the restart fails loud with admission closed and no open frames sent

preconditions.notes: The append-only settlement path is blocked (the step log path is a directory), so the bounded reconcile helper cannot write its terminal line and the replacement Worker stays silent.

timeline.event: journal dispatched acked; one step open

timeline.detail: the runtime holds the dispatched record but the terminal line cannot be written

timeline.event: planned restart reaches the reconcile helper deadline
timeline.detail: the helper fails and the restart throws
admission stays closed and the failure is reported to the caller

timeline.event: no open frames after the failure
timeline.detail: exactly the pre-restart FENCE and LIFECYCLE count remains: no post-recovery pair is sent

notes: journal_gap is unmeasured because this test asserts the failure and the closed admission, not the surviving step record; the companion early-failure test does assert the terminal abandoned record for an engine, HELLO or lease failure. A runner must not require Failed to be recoverable: only an explicit user reset leaves it.
